decisions.decision: D-09 amended: WSSI rendering floor is MINOR and above; WINTER WEATHER AREA renders nothing
decisions.rationale: Research live-verified that WPC's WSSI renderer domain has NO 'LIMITED' tier. Real domain is WINTER WEATHER AREA -> MINOR -> MODERATE -> MAJOR -> EXTREME. D-09's original wording referenced a tier that does not exist. User confirmed the MINOR floor; WPC's own service description calls WINTER WEATHER AREA 'not anticipated to impact daily life'. Recorded as an AMENDED block in 15-CONTEXT.md, commit d1afcc2.

decisions.decision: MPD Last-Modified pre-filter (~48h) is a fetch-count optimization ONLY; ValidEndTi is the authoritative active/inactive gate
decisions.rationale: Research Open Question 2. Letting the pre-filter decide inclusion would reintroduce a false-negative class, against the project's core value.

decisions.decision: Retired md socket element removed outright, no compatibility shim
decisions.rationale: Research Open Question 3. No other consumer exists in this single-instance deployment; project has a no-legacy-fallback precedent.

decisions.decision: Probe harness resolves REAL adm-zip/xmldom/togeojson/xpath with a requires:'kml-deps' skip that forces non-zero exit; @turf/turf stays stubbed
decisions.rationale: Planner-resolved conflict between the harness's dependency-free design and the need to drive real KMZ bytes. Rejected option (pre-decoded fixtures) would have given up coverage of extractSoleKmlEntry's doc.kml selection, togeojson's description-object shape, and fetchBinBuffer's binary path.

decisions.decision: ERO day-loop EXTRACTED into a shared runner rather than copied for WSSI
decisions.rationale: Copy-pasting would recreate exactly the WR-06 divergence D-02 exists to prevent. Both excessiveRain and winterImpact now route through _runArcGisDayProduct.

decisions.decision: MD_HOST_PREFIX replaced with hostname-parsed normalizeAdvisoryUrl (not a prefix tweak)
decisions.rationale: Fixed the live outage (ActiveMD.kmz serves http:// against a hardcoded https:// prefix) AND closed the prefix-match bypass, where https://www.wpc.ncep.noaa.gov.attacker.example/ would satisfy a startsWith check. 8 negative cases verified.

decisions.decision: showSPCMD defaults true, deviating from CFG-01
decisions.rationale: SPC MD is a shipping feature being migrated, not a new product; defaulting it false would silently delete a live capability. Flagged to the user at plan time; not contested.
